catalogueRules.productFamilyRule: Closely related official variants belong under one PRODUCT_FAMILY card instead of separate top-level cards.
catalogueRules.heroImageRule: For PRODUCT_FAMILY entries, prefer an official manufacturer group/lineup image that shows the family or collection. Fall back to a representative official variant only if no official family image exists.
catalogueRules.variantRule: Size, storage, colour, chip, fit, capacity or closely related sibling models belong inside variants when appropriate.
catalogueRules.mediaFailureRule: If no authoritative matching image is found, set mediaStatus=NEEDS_REVIEW; never substitute an unrelated product.
catalogueRules.servicesRule: PROCUREMENT_SERVICE entries use service visuals, not fake manufacturer product photos.
